structural.description: Verify the trace as a self-consistent artifact without dereferencing private policy/fact sources.
prerequisites: no private policy bytes or selector source facts are required
structural.pass_condition: Every required structural check executes and passes.
structural.fail_condition: Any required structural check executes and fails.
structural.indeterminate_condition: No required structural check fails, but schema validation or another required verifier capability is unavailable.

replay.description: Structural verification plus deterministic replay against the referenced policy set and selector facts.
prerequisites: exact policy-set bytes matching policy_set.digest are available
all referenced policy revision bytes are available
canonical selector facts and selector definitions are available
policy inheritance graph and policy algebra/resolver semantics are available
replay.pass_condition: Structural PASS plus every replay check executes and reproduces the recorded selector, merge, operation, stage, gate and result state exactly.
replay.fail_condition: Structural FAIL, any digest mismatch, selector/inheritance/operation mismatch, unauthorized grant, missing deny/lock/operation evidence, stage/gate divergence, or final effective-policy digest mismatch.
replay.indeterminate_condition: Structural is not FAIL, but replay cannot complete because one or more required private inputs, policy revisions, selector facts, resolver semantics, or replay capabilities are unavailable.

sealed.description: Replay verification plus tamper-evident event-chain verification.
prerequisites: every event has event_hash and correct prev_event_hash linkage
sealed.pass_condition: Replay PASS plus the complete RFC8785-JCS/SHA-256 chain recomputes exactly and both declared chain heads match the final event hash.
sealed.fail_condition: Replay FAIL; hash_chain is absent/disabled; required hash fields are missing; unsupported/incorrect declared hash profile; any event hash/link mismatch; or terminal chain-head mismatch.
sealed.indeterminate_condition: Replay is not FAIL and the trace declares a complete enabled seal, but the verifier cannot execute required canonicalization/cryptographic checks or referenced sealed bytes are unavailable.

rules.assert: document validates against /policy-resolution-trace.schema.json
events[i].seq == i for every event
every event_id is unique
every cause_event_id exists and references an event with lower seq
all internal event references resolve exactly once
RFC8785-JCS SHA-256 of resolved policy-set input equals policy_set.digest
each referenced policy revision hashes to its declared digest
canonical selector facts hash to selector_facts_digest
re-evaluating each selector reproduces clause outcomes, matched flag, fallback eligibility/suppression, specificity class and ordering
every matched tag clause in a replayable trace has fact provenance or is covered by the selector-facts digest; tag provenance never supplies grant authority
rules.indeterminate_when: A matched tag clause is digest-covered but the private canonical tag source required to verify provenance is unavailable; structural presence check may still PASS while replay becomes INDETERMINATE.

rules.assert: topological expansion reproduces every inheritance_step; cycles yield rejected_policy_set
every operation from every matched/effective inherited policy emits exactly one operation_evaluated event
given before + operand + policy algebra, recomputation yields recorded outcome and after
every grant_decision has exactly one grant_evaluated; accepted grants require authority_source=user_explicit, authorization_ref, unexpired authority, valid scope, and no blocking lock/explicit deny
every explicit/default/conflict/reapplied/condition/expired/missing deny that affects state has one deny_applied event
every lock acquisition, inheritance, reapply, or blocked write that affects state has a lock_applied event
replaying operations through each stage reproduces gate_decisions and state_digest
exactly one gate_final exists for read, remember, acknowledge, answer, draft, act, escalate
each gate_final decision/scope/provenance agrees with replayed final effective policy and gate_results
exactly one resolution_final exists and result.final_event_id references it
canonical final effective policy hashes to result.effective_policy_digest and resolution_final.effective_policy_digest
privacy.raw_payload_embedded == false and no event payload embeds source message/body content
privacy.secret_values_embedded == false; sensitive values use ref/digest/redacted trace_value forms
hash_chain exists and hash_chain.enabled == true
canonicalization == RFC8785-JCS and algorithm == SHA-256
event_hash equals SHA-256(JCS(event excluding event_hash)) and prev_event_hash equals preceding event_hash; first prev_event_hash is null
hash_chain.chain_head equals final event_hash and resolution_final.chain_head

aggregation: Evaluate only checks required by the requested profile plus all inherited lower-profile checks.
If any required ERROR check is FAIL => profile FAIL.
Else if any required ERROR check is INDETERMINATE => profile INDETERMINATE.
WARN checks never change profile status.
result_algorithm.FAIL: A required contract violation is proven.
result_algorithm.INDETERMINATE: No violation is proven, but required verification evidence/capability is missing.
result_algorithm.PASS: All required evidence was available and every required assertion passed.

principles.evidence_law: PASS means every required check for the requested profile actually executed and passed.
principles.failure_law: FAIL means available evidence proves the trace/profile contract was violated.
principles.indeterminate_law: INDETERMINATE means no required check failed, but one or more required checks could not be executed because required evidence or verifier capability was unavailable.
principles.inheritance_law: replay requires structural PASS; sealed requires replay PASS.
principles.no_optimistic_upgrade: A higher profile never upgrades a lower-profile FAIL or INDETERMINATE.

check.PASS: The check executed against all evidence required by that check and the assertion held.
check.FAIL: The check executed far enough to prove its assertion false, or a profile-required artifact/field is explicitly absent where absence violates the profile.
check.INDETERMINATE: The assertion cannot be decided because evidence or verifier capability required by the check is unavailable.
check.SKIP: The check is not applicable to the requested profile or its documented 'when' predicate is false.

profile.FAIL: At least one required ERROR check is FAIL.
profile.INDETERMINATE: No required ERROR check is FAIL and at least one required ERROR check is INDETERMINATE.

failure_vs_indeterminate_examples.why: Evidence is present and proves invalid structure.
Verifier capability is missing; validity is unknown.

failure_vs_indeterminate_examples.case: recorded policy digest differs from supplied policy bytes
policy bytes are private and not supplied
grant marked accepted but authority_source != user_explicit
sealed profile requested but hash_chain.enabled == false
seal is present but verifier lacks RFC8785-JCS implementation
hash link recomputes to a different digest
